## Signing

Contributions are accepted only from signers of this Agreement, except for
automated accounts and coding agents named in the workflow allowlist, which
cannot themselves sign; the human opening the pull request remains responsible
for the representations above.

Sign electronically by commenting the following on your pull request, exactly:

```
I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA
```

You sign once; the signature covers all of Your Contributions to the Project,
past and future.

**Record kept.** Signing stores your GitHub username, the text of your comment,
and a timestamp in the `cla-signatures` branch of this repository. That record
is retained for as long as the Project exists, because it is the evidence of
the licenses granted above. It is public if this repository is public.

If you are contributing on behalf of a company and your employer requires its
own agreement rather than the representations in section 5, contact
kyle.j.caron@gmail.com before opening a pull request.
